values.value: Finds: Opportunity records with IsWon=true AND Amount=0 closed in the last 90 days. Why it matters: Closing a known cancel as won-at-zero (instead of close-lost) is a non-standard CPQ pattern that hides churn from whitespace, churn, and renewal reporting until the autoclose fires. Customers using this workaround typically have a blind spot of weeks-to-months on real-time retention numbers. Surfaces immediately as a data-shape signal. Suppress a finding: when the opportunity is a legitimate $0 deal (trial, internal, partner-funded, accommodation). Note the reason and dismiss. Disable the detector: only if your org intentionally uses close-won-at-zero as the cancel path. Most should leave this on so the pattern is at least visible.
